entries.zh: 世情，时俗（一时一地的风气）
entries.en: the custom of the age; the ways of the world

entries.zh: 俗套；陈规惯例，习惯作法
entries.notes: R 栏「su tan」疑为「su tau（俗套）」之讹，M 栏第二音节「ho」与「套」不协，故以 H 栏为准。

entries.en: customs, mores (of a place or people)
morals and customs; to instruct and improve by moral example

entries.zh: 恶俗，不良风气（字面「材草」谓粗劣无用之物）
entries.en: bad customs, corrupt habits (lit. 'coarse timber and grass', i.e. worthless stuff)
entries.notes: 「材草」非经见之词，义据 L 栏 malas costumbres 及闽南语「粗劣无用」喻义推定，字形亦可能微残。
L 栏「Costa」疑为「Cota（锁子甲、铠甲）」之讹，R 栏「guia」疑即「gia（甲）」。

entries.zh: 比对，较量（闽南语「比并」）；看货比价
entries.en: to compare, to match up; to appraise goods for purchase
entries.notes: L 栏「g.」为未详缩写（疑「y」之讹，读作 cotejar y comprar），H 栏「並」与 M 栏「pi Peng」实为「比并」，故主训比对。

entries.en: to match, to be equal to (a sample or model)
entries.notes: M 栏「Pit yõ」溢出 H 栏单字「匹」，疑与第 12 条「匹樣」重出；音标栏 T99 污损。

entries.en: to compare good and bad; to judge quality
entries.notes: 「怯」为闽南语 khiap（劣、丑）之借字，非「怯懦」本义。

entries.en: to compare against, to check whether it corresponds
entries.notes: H 栏「北」疑为「比」之讹，M、R 两栏均作 pi。

entries.en: to compare; to proportion, to make commensurate
entries.notes: H 栏「北」疑为「比」之讹（同第 10 条），M、R 两栏均作 pi。

entries.en: to match a pattern or sample
entries.notes: 音标栏 T99 污损，然 L/H/M/R 四栏语义一致，字形可辨。

entries.en: to conform to, to correspond with (the original)
to divide equally, to apportion in shares
entries.notes: L 栏与第 13 条重复作 conformarse，而 H 栏「對分」训均分，两义并存，此条取 H 栏。

entries.en: to match by kind or class

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（L 疑为 coyunda「牛轭、轭带」）
entries.en: doubtful: possibly 'yoke, harness strap' (coyunda); the Chinese columns are corrupt
entries.notes: 四栏互不相应：M「ley pe tu」与 R「pi pi to」不合，H 栏三字皆带疑，L 字形亦疑。
